title: Temporary capacity reduction on Asia–Mediterranean services
summary: Blank sailings are planned across two loops while the network is rebalanced. Expect tighter equipment availability through the end of the month.

title: Peak season surcharge applied to selected Gulf routes
summary: A peak season surcharge will apply to dry containers moving westbound from East Asia. Rates may vary by equipment type and booking date.

title: Peak Season Surcharge on Asia-MENA Trade Lanes
summary: MSC announced a new peak season surcharge affecting selected Asia-MENA shipments. Equipment availability remains constrained across regional hubs.

title: Schedule Adjustment for Red Sea Corridor Services
summary: Revised vessel routing schedules implemented to maintain schedule reliability across Middle East trade corridors.
